newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom leads NZ share market to lower close.
newsitem.headline: Telecom leads NZ share market to lower close.

text.p: * Volume light, market in holiday mode
* Small companies index surges nearly 1 percent
Lead stock Telecom lead a lethargic New Zealand share market lower on Monday.
Brokers said the market was in holiday mode and they expect it to continue to drift listlessly on Tuesday into the holiday.
The top 40 index fell 6.17 to 2343.81, in stark contrast to a sharp 47.06 gain in the small companies index to 5002.58.
Volume was a light $40 million and even that figure was boosted by two large transactions already reported on Friday.
Brokers said there had been chunky overseas selling in Telecom which was exerting downward pressure on the overall market.
Number two stock Carter Holt Harvey fell two cents to $3.28 while Fletcher Paper gained the same to $2.79.
Summit again performed well following the promising report at an Australian uranium prospect. It gained nine cents to 69.
